## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new functionality
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor` — code change, no behaviour change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `build` — build system, packaging, dependencies
- [ ] `ci` — CI configuration
- [ ] `chore` — maintenance
- [ ] `revert` — revert of a prior commit

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).
- [ ] Commits are signed (verified on GitHub).
- [ ] Commits have a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Branch name follows `<type>/<short-kebab-description>`.
- [ ] Rebased onto the latest `main`; no merge commits.
